name: Rosuvastatin
summary: A potent statin often chosen when strong LDL lowering is needed with relatively little CYP3A4 interaction burden.
good: High-intensity LDL reduction or patients who need a statin with fewer CYP3A4 issues.
bad: Any unexplained muscle toxicity signal that has not been evaluated.
clinicalPearls: It is a potency choice as much as an interaction choice.
mechanism: Same HMG-CoA reductase inhibition class effect as other statins.
indications: High-intensity LDL lowering, mixed dyslipidemia, and high-risk cardiovascular prevention.
interactionNotes: Still worth checking interaction burden, but it is less CYP3A4-dependent than atorvastatin.

warnings: Muscle symptoms, liver enzyme elevation, and dose caution in kidney impairment are the main themes.
